answer.reason: The verses tell of the city's capture and renaming by the Danites and of Jeroboam's golden calf set up there, which are its defining events.

clauses.english: was taken from Laish by the Danites, who burnt it and renamed it Dan
clauses.quote: they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire

clauses.english: was where Jeroboam set up a golden calf for the people to worship
clauses.quote: the other put he in Dan

doubts: Verses where Dan appears only in the phrase 'from Dan even to Beersheba' were left out as boundary markers.
GEN 14:14 (Abram's pursuit to Dan) was left out as a stage of a journey.
2SA 24:6 'Danjaan' may be a different place and was not used.
JOS 19:47 repeats the capture of Leshem and was not cited separately.
The tribe and the patriarch Dan are not the place; AMO 8:14 and EZK 27:19 are unclear on whether they mean the city or the tribe and were not used.
